Wg.bar_b_note: The naturalistic boar fur model is close to the owner bar, but the flat unrimmed stage light, a body no taller than the 1.80 m trainer and (A) a swim frame where it walks on top of the water sink the finish.

Oc.bar_b_note: Same boar as Wg: a convincing fur model, but flat stage light, scale at or under the trainer and (B) a swim frame that stands on the water instead of swimming keep it short of shipping finish.

Kr.bar_b_note: A clean, expressive, appealing elder with a readable face and an earthy olive/brown palette that fits the key-art world at a Palworld-class character finish.

Dj.bar_b_note: The lean naturalistic coyote reads well and its faint poses stay grounded, but the flat grey stage light, no rim and (B) a swim frame where it walks on the surface stop it from reading as shipping finish.

Pw.bar_b_note: Same coyote as Dj: solid anatomy and fur, let down by the flat stage light and (A) a swim frame where it walks on the water plane, with a white-blown edge on the water.

Pb.bar_b_note: B's large gold ingredient lines and wrapped recipe text read well, but the plain white Craft/Leave hints with tiny keyboard glyphs, no teal button treatment and a dim low-poly storm backdrop fall short of shipping UI polish.

Ub.bar_b_note: A dark brown, one-value forest with no purple storm sky, flat magenta ring and slab telegraphs, a barely visible player creature and a dense HUD sink it (A also has the camera buried in canopy).

Oz.bar_b_note: Neither cobra reaches the board's olive-scale and gold-lightning finish: A's mottled texture turns to noise and hides the trainer, and B's flat yellow bands and levitating faint poses break the read.

top_changes.change: Replace the flat magenta telegraph rings/slabs in Stormwood fights with real lightning/impact effects, fade occluding trunks and canopy, and lift the combat grade (purple storm sky, rim light on both fighters, smaller HUD footprint)

Fix creature grounding and scale in presentation: swim frames sink the body to the waterline instead of walking on the surface, Fulgocobra faint poses stay on the ground, boar scaled clearly above the 1.80 m trainer, plus rim light on the creature stage
Re-surface Fulgocobra to the board's look (dark olive scales, gold lightning cracks, cream belly) instead of mottled noise or flat yellow bands
